create_kv_cache: create a KVCache instance with num_blocks, num_heads, head_size, dtype and device for attention layers
store_kv_in_cache: store key and value tensors into the KVCache at specified slots using the store method
load_kv_scales: load FP8 key-value cache scales from a Weights object using get_kv_scales with a prefix
reshape_and_cache_paged: reshape and cache key-value tensors into paged attention cache using paged_reshape_and_cache for CUDA, ROCm or IPEX
check_kv_cache_scaling: check if a KVCache can be scaled by given KVScales using the can_scale method
